messages:
secops-bot: Vulnerability scan alert for image redwood/core:2026-03-05-abc123 flagged UNKNOWN_ATTESTATION for layer 4. Priority HIGH. See /incidents/ID-472.

maria: saw this. Attestation check failed but image passed previous sigstore check last week. Repro? :thinking:

jamal: checking builder logs, hold on. Which cluster?

maria: prod-dedicated-west-2. A few requests from billing-service started failing with 403 from admission-controller.

olivia: admission logs show: "attestation: missing key id". KMS rotation last night? @kevin any changes to encryption keys?

kevin: rotated GCP KMS key for signing pipeline at 02:14 UTC. We updated KMS arn in the builder but didn't roll over verifier config. Likely mismatch.

maria: ok that explains missing key id. But scanner also reported a CVE in openssl layer flagged by clair-local as high. Can that be a false positive from squashed layers?

jamal: attaching small snippet from scanner:
```
CVE-2022-XYZ: /usr/local/lib/libssl.so.1.1 -> version 1.1.1k
Detected at offset: layer 4
Layer digest: sha256:abcd...
```

olivia: our base image has openssl patched to 1.1.1m in the final image, but older layers show older version artifacts—scanner is not accounting for file replacements during build.

maria: So two things: (1) verifier config needs key id update to match rotated KMS key, (2) triage the vuln report as potential layering false positive. Agreed?

kevin: I'll update verifier config in rollout at 12:30 PT and add a canary to dedicated clusters. Will also publish a short runbook step to avoid future mismatch.

jamal: For the vuln triage I'll run difffs between source and image and re-scan with --follow-symlinks disabled. If it persists I'll reproduce locally and share results.

olivia: Also let's dump admission-controller audit logs to the auditpipe index (splunk) so SRE/CS can see timeline. I can add the query.

maria: timeline/owners: kevin -> KMS/verifier config, jamal -> vuln triage, olivia -> auditpipe logs. Target ETA EOD PDT. React with :thumbsup: when done.

secops-bot: Incident ID INC-472 updated: owner changed to kevin. Links: https://incidents.redwood/INC-472

kevin: started rollout. patch notes: update SIGNER_KEY_ID env for verifier, add 1m backoff. Will post completion.

jamal: scanned locally; false positive confirmed — older artifact in intermediate layer, final image OK. Will annotate scanner ticket and close CVE as FP pending SRE sign-off.

olivia: auditpipe query (Splunk):
```
index=audit logs | search "admission-controller" "attestation" | stats count by pod, user, message
```

maria: perfect. leaving notes in the image registry metadata: reason=attestation-drift, kms-rotation, vuln-scan-fp. Closing thread once kevin confirms verifier rollout.

kevin: rollout complete at 12:46 PT. verifier now accepts new KMS key id. Admission errors cleared in prod. :white_check_mark:

maria: verified in prod, no regressions. closing. Thanks all. :tada:
